description:
Get the direct MP4 links of public Instagram reels, video posts and carousels by link, without login (3-15 s).
Plan cost: 1 MCPize call (Free 100/mo, Pro $9/1,000, Business $29/5,000). Hard cap: max 10 post links per call.

post_links: reel, post or /tv/ links or bare shortcodes, e.g. ["https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeC12b5uha9/"].

Returns one record per link: status (ok when the post has a video; otherwise statusReason says why), shortCode,
postUrl, postType, ownerUsername, ownerFullName, isVerified, caption, takenAt, likes, comments, videoCount,
videoUrl (MP4 with sound), audioUrl (the sound alone), thumbnailUrl, durationSeconds, expiresAt (Instagram's links
expire after about 32 to 36 hours) and videos: one entry per video (slide number for carousels) with
originalWidth, originalHeight, hasAudio and qualities (label, width, height, bitrate, bytes, url; every rendition
up to 1080p, which has no sound: join it with audioUrl using ffmpeg). Upstream failures return ToolError with HTTP status.
name: get_instagram_videos
